title: Successor map for record tests
statement: For a natural number $k$, a type $Q$, and a record-test index, define a partial successor map from its assigned phase type to a record-test index and its phase. A completed state scan moves to the forward index carrying the scanned optional state and $j=0$. A completed forward scan increments $j$ while $j+1<k+2$, and otherwise moves to the tag index carrying the same state and begins its forward scan; a completed tag scan moves to the backward index carrying the scanned Boolean and $j=k+1$. A completed backward phase decrements $j$ while $j\ne0$, and at $j=0$ moves to the verdict index with the same Boolean. All other state, forward, tag, and backward phases have no successor, and verdict indices have no successor in any phase.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a record-test index with the bounds and parameters specified by its constructor
